name: instituto-santa-ana-luz-del-carmen
description: Website for Instituto Santa Ana Luz del Carmen

scripts.start:all: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = Start-Process node -ArgumentList 'server.js' -PassThru; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Start-Process 'http://localhost:3000'; Start-Process 'http://localhost:3000/admin.html'; Wait-Process -Id $p.Id"
